source.extractionPreview:
14
A PRESENTATION OF DANCE 
AND CHOREOGRAPHY
You are familiar with the Nāṭyaśhāstra and the Abhinaya Darpaṇam now. 
In ancient times, when they were written, dance was usually called nr̥ tta and 
nr̥ itya or nartana, whereas dance-drama was called nāṭya. 
Have you ever wondered how dance originated? 
If you refer to your Grade 6 Arts textbook (Theatre), you will recall an 
interesting story about the birth of the performing arts. Similarly, you will 
learn about the birth of dance from the Abhin
